sentences: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women.
Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
translations: 法国，这个以全球时尚创新者自居的国家，已经认定其时尚产业失去了定义女性身体美的绝对权利。
上周，法国立法者初步批准了一项法律，该法律将雇用超瘦模特走秀定为犯罪。
议会还同意禁止那些通过宣扬极端节食来“煽动过度瘦身”的网站。

sentences: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives.
They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health.
That's a start.
And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death – as some have done.

It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape-measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
translations: 这些措施背后有几个令人振奋的动机。
它们表明，美丽不应由最终损害健康的外表来定义。
这是一个开始。
而且，对超瘦模特的禁令似乎不仅仅是为了保护模特免于像一些人那样把自己饿死。
它告诉时尚产业，必须为自己向女性，尤其是少女，传递的关于她们必须用来衡量自身价值的“社会标尺”的信号负责。

sentences: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
translations: 这些禁令如果得到全面执行，将向女性（以及许多男性）表明，她们不应让他人成为自己美丽的仲裁者。
并且，或许隐约地，它们暗示人们应该关注如品格和才智等无形的品质，而不是通过节食来达到零号身材或蜂腰体型。

sentences: The French measures, however, rely too much on severe punishment to change a culture that still regards beauty as skin-deep – and bone-showing.
Under the law, using a fashion model that does not meet a government-defined index of body mass could result in a $85,000 fine and six months in prison.
translations: 然而，法国的措施过于依赖严厉的惩罚来改变一种仍然将美丽视为肤浅（甚至瘦骨嶙峋）的文化。
根据该法律，使用不符合政府定义的身体质量指数的时装模特，可能导致8.5万美元的罚款和六个月的监禁。

sentences: The fashion industry knows it has an inherent problem in focusing on material adornment and idealized body types.
In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
translations: 时尚产业知道，其专注于物质装饰和理想化体型本身存在固有问题。
在丹麦、美国和其他几个国家，它正试图为模特和时尚形象设定自愿性标准，这些标准更多依赖同行压力来执行。

sentences: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people."
The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen Fashion Week (CFW), which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute.
But in general it relies on a name-and-shame method of compliance.
translations: 与法国的行动形成对比的是，丹麦的时尚产业上个月就模特的年龄、健康及其他特征达成了规则和制裁措施。
新修订的《丹麦时尚道德宪章》明确指出：“我们意识到并承担时尚产业对身体形象，尤其是对年轻人所产生的影响的责任。”
该宪章的主要执行工具是禁止设计师和模特经纪公司参加由丹麦时尚协会主办的哥本哈根时装周。
但总的来说，它依赖于点名羞辱的方式来确保合规。

sentences: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
translations: 依靠道德劝说而非法律来解决身体形象被滥用的问题，可能是最佳举措。
更好的做法是帮助提升美的观念，使其超越特定行业的物质标准。

sentences:
21. According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France?
A. Physical beauty would be redefined.
B. New runways would be constructed.
C. Websites about dieting would thrive.
D. The fashion industry would decline.
translations:
21. 根据第一段，法国会发生什么？
A. 身体美将被重新定义。
B. 将建造新的跑道。
C. 关于节食的网站将会蓬勃发展。
D. 时尚产业将会衰退。

sentences:
22. The phrase "impinging on" (Line 2, Para. 2) is closest in meaning to____
A. indicating the state of.
B. heightening the value of.
C. losing faith in.
D. doing harm to.
translations:
22. 短语“impinging on”（第二段第二行）在意思上最接近____
A. 表明……的状态。
B. 提高……的价值。
C. 对……失去信心。
D. 对……造成伤害。

sentences:
23. Which of the following is true of the fashion industry?
A. The French measures have already failed.
B. Its inherent problems are getting worse.
C. Models are no longer under peer pressure.
D. New standards are being set in Denmark.
translations:
23. 下列关于时尚产业的说法哪一项是正确的？
A. 法国的措施已经失败。
B. 其固有的问题正在恶化。
C. 模特不再承受同行压力。
D. 丹麦正在制定新标准。

sentences:
24. A designer is most likely to be rejected by CFW for____
A. pursuing perfect physical conditions.
B. caring too much about models' character.
C. showing little concern for health factors.
D. setting a high age threshold for models.
translations:
24. 设计师最有可能因为____而被CFW拒绝。
A. 追求完美的身体条件。
B. 过于关注模特的性格。
C. 对健康因素漠不关心。
D. 为模特设定过高的年龄门槛。

sentences:
25. Which of the following may be the best title of the text?
A. The Great Threats to the Fashion Industry
B. Just Another Round of Struggle for Beauty
C. A Dilemma for the Starving Models in France
D. A Challenge to the Fashion Industry's Body Ideals
translations:
25. 以下哪一项可能是本文的最佳标题？
A. 时尚产业的巨大威胁
B. 又一场为美而进行的斗争
C. 法国饥饿模特的困境
D. 对时尚产业身体理想的挑战
